text:
maya: heads up, starting a staggered rollout of runtime-engine v2.14-quant into night window. small regions first, then global if green
liam: thanks — what's the slice size and cadence?
maya: slice 2% per region, 10m between batches, will cordon new hosts for canary-only traffic. fallback policy = immediate pin to v2.13 if errors > 1% on token errors or p95 latency +120ms
ana-qa: tagging @ana-qa — QA queue has the new quant smoke tests queued, will run the 8 failing prompts from last run as a priority
ana-qa: ETA for smoke results ~18m
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout started: runtime-engine:v2.14-quant -> regions: iad, ewr (2% slice) (initiated by maya)
jorge: added a quick telemetry check in staging: look for matmul-err >= 1 or kvcache-thrash spikes. pushing alert query to ops dashboard
samir: pinging infra to hold autoscale for ewr for 30m, don't let new nodes join canary pool
ops-bot: [ops-bot] autoscale hold applied to pool runtime-ewr-canary for 00:30
maya: smoke hit: first batch healthy, 0.2% token errors, p95 +10ms. continuing to iad next
liam: note: release notes need the quant ABI bump line and the mitigations (compat shim + fallback). i'll draft and drop in #eng-releases
ana-qa: iad smoke finished: two prompts had small token distortions (probable rounding), stored examples in S3: s3://redwood-qa/quant-v2.14/iad-smoke-3367890123.json
maya: thanks. metric check looks okay, promoting ewr -> iad progressive slice next region ordinals
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] slice 4% -> iad, ewr -> ordinals completed, next region ord: syd at T+30m
jorge: timeline: syd at 00:45 UTC. can we gate syd until QA approves recorded examples?
maya: yes, gating syd. @ana-qa please review the stored examples when you can, we'll hold global until +OK
ana-qa: reviewing now. quick note: profiler shows a 0.7% increase in small matrix kernel retries in quant path on one host 
liam: curious if that's noise or a driver mismatch. which host?
ana-qa: host-rtl-12 in iad during run; I put logs in the ticket #ENG-7421
samir: that host is on driver 525.60, others are on 525.45. could be driver-specific kernel fallback path
maya: decision: cordon host-rtl-12 from canary pool, continue rollout elsewhere. mark for investigation and add to the next freeze list if flaky
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] host-rtl-12 cordoned from runtime-canary pool by maya
ops-bot: [ops-bot] incident ticket created ENG-7421, assigned to jorge
jorge: grabbing the logs now; I'll repro on 525.60 locally and check kernel call traces
liam: if it's a driver mismatch we should add a compatibility note in release notes and recommend 525.45 for now
maya: agree. for rollback criteria: if we see token errors >0.8% sustained over two slices OR p95 delta >100ms on national routes, auto-pin to v2.13 and notify #incidents
ana-qa: SYD hold released — QA thumbs on examples, no new anomalies after cordon. green to proceed but keep watch on host-rtl-12 followups
maya: ok proceeding with syd slice at 2% then increasing cadence to 10m between batches
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] syd slice started 2% (gated by QA)
samir: leaving autoscale hold in place until we clear this wave, ops will unhold after midnight UTC or on explicit thumbs
liam: release notes draft is in the PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/engine-2.14 — includes driver compatibility note and rollback criteria
maya: if things look stable after the next 3 regions, we finalize and publish notes. otherwise we'll hit the pin and roll back plan
ana-qa: final quick: add the failing prompt IDs to the regression monitor so we don't miss future flaps
maya: good call. I'll create the monitor after rollout completes
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout progress: regions completed: iad, ewr, syd (slices 2%,4%,2%). next: lhr at T+20m
liam: one more ops ask — can we annotate request traces with engine-variant=v2.14-quant so SLO dashboards can split?
ops-bot: [ops-bot] trace annotation enabled for canary traffic (engine-variant header appended)
maya: thanks everyone. keep alerts loud if you see anything strange. i'll be on standby until global completes
jorge: reproed a small kernel retry locally on 525.60, filing a driver compatibility PR to our staging kernels repo. won't block rollback but will be a hotfix if it recurs
samir: noted. if we hit rollback, follow the pin playbook: deploy-bot pin v2.13, drain canary, rollback orchestration, notify customers via status page
maya: copy. let's reconvene after lhr slice metrics (T+30m).
